overview: Before you went back to the Theatre you looked at Egeon's roll and wrote three words in the margin. You did not copy a speech. The afternoon bill is The Comedy of Errors, and you play.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the caution and did not copy a speech.
